Draw a coherent continuous village overview viewed gently from above as a storybook illustration, NOT a 3D render or isometric toy diorama. Layout: bottom left recognizable autumn forest entry and broad stepping-stone stream crossing; left middle a small glowing glass greenhouse; center left a welcoming indigo timber restaurant with bowl-and-ladle hanging sign and amber windows; middle a generous cream snowy village lane and low footbridge over turquoise water; center right a teal wooden toy workshop with a large toy-boat sign; lower right a small cranberry post house with a large envelope sign; a nearby village window with a brush-shaped sign belongs to the painter. Upper right at the end of the lane stands a lovely blue-lavender fairytale castle with simple rounded towers, courtyard, one Christmas tree and a small empty music dais. Nordic-inspired steep timber gables, restrained evergreen garlands, paper-like star lanterns, a few wrapped gifts, snow caps on roofs and firs, warm windows. Retain a few rich autumn trees around the entrance so the confirmed art family remains recognizable; farther village and castle are wintry blue. Clear separate landmark silhouettes; open uncluttered lanes connect all destinations. Christmas community mood cozy and inviting, no crisis. Environmental overview only, NO characters, no mermaids, no Santa, no text, no numbers, no title, no interface, no watermark. A beautiful art director's rough world proposal with enough spatial clarity to annotate externally.
